{{Multiple choice|You can either complete this quest, or [[Choose Your Friends Wisely]] from [[Skier]].
Completing this quest is required to complete the Savior ending route.}} {{Infobox quest |image =The Price of Independence Banner.png |location =[[Customs]], [[Reserve]], [[Woods]], [[Lighthouse]] |given by =[[BTR Driver]] |previous =[[Discombobulate]] |leads to = |related =[[Choose Your Friends Wisely]] |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|We foiled Skier's plans, and I'll tell you this - we can't let this opportunity slip away. When he recovers, he will never let me out of his sight. That's why we need to think of a defensive plan now, because you and I are both going to get nailed! So listen, I've got a plan all worked out. Except I don't have anybody else I'd trust to do something this complex. I was able to dig up some background intel on Skier. The kind of information that could compromise him real bad if it fell into the right hands. It's all in this letter, and it's our guarantee. You need to pick it up at the customs area. The letter will be on the top floor of the building by the construction site. You know, the one near the railroad platform, you'll see it. Hopefully. From there, go straight to the reserve base and leave it in the headquarters on the third floor, at the fortified point with windows. The key is to make sure that Skier's men don't intercept the letter. That is why after stashing the letter, run to Priozersk and make some noise. After you kill a couple of Scavs, go to the lighthouse peninsula and shoot a flare. You need a yellow one, don't get it mixed up! The best place to do it is on the pier at the vacation houses and on the platform at the train station, it'll distract the guys from Skier's nearest base. After that, you run out of there! I've written all the instructions on a piece of paper to make sure you don't fuck it up. You gotta do it all at once, you understand?}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Incriminating letter|incriminating letter]] on [[Customs]] * Use the transit from [[Customs]] to [[Reserve]] * Stash the [[Incriminating letter|letter]] on the third floor of the military headquarters on [[Reserve]] * Use the transit from [[Reserve]] to [[Woods]] * Eliminate any 3 targets on [[Woods]] * Use the transit from [[Woods]] to [[Lighthouse]] * Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station warehouse on [[Lighthouse]] * Launch a yellow signal flare at the pier on [[Lighthouse]] * Survive and extract from [[Lighthouse]] * Eliminate 10 [[Scavs]] while completing the other objectives ==Rewards== * +85,400 [[EXP]] * [[BTR Driver]] Rep '''+0.5''' * 300,000 Roubles * Unlocks barter for [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue)]] at [[Mechanic]] LL2 * Unlocks barter for [[Graphics card]] at [[Mechanic]] LL3 * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|All-Wheel Drive]] {{quote|Ho-ly shit! You did it! You're the only one to stick up for me. What's most important is that we've already prepared the stage. It won't be easy, but Prapor promised to help, and the letter ought to work too. I won't forget all the help you've given me. Drop by often, friend.}} ==Failure Dialogue== {{quote|It didn't work out, friend. Skier has intercepted the damn letter. We sure were close, weren't we? Nobody even knew about this! I guess I don't have any options to break away from Skier yet.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Incriminating letter Icon.png|link=Incriminating letter]] |[[Incriminating letter]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |''This [[Quests#Quest items|quest item]] can only be found if the quest is active.''
''When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.''
''If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.'' |- ! colspan="6" |Flare - You only need one of the below options |- ![[File:Yellow flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |2 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the specified areas. |- ! colspan="6" |OR |- ![[File:SP-81 Icon.png|link=ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |[[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to fire the flare cartridge |- ![[File:26x75 flare cartridge (Yellow) icon.png|link=26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |2 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the specified areas. |} In this quest you first have to find the [[Incriminating letter]] on the third floor in the northern building of the industrial plant on [[Customs]]. Afterwards you have to transit to [[Reserve]] and stash it on the third floor of the military headquarters (Black Bishop). Next you have to transit to [[Woods]] and kill any 3 targets there. Lastly you need to transit to [[Lighthouse]] and launch a yellow flare at the train station and the pier, and extract. While doing these objectives, 10 [[Scavs]] also need to be killed. Dying or extracting at any point before completing all objectives will reset fulfilled objectives besides collecting the [[Incriminating letter]]. ===[[Customs]] Letter location=== The letter can be found in different spots in the office on the third floor of the northern building at the industrial plant.
